description: First there was ChemCam on Mars rover Curiosity. Now, SuperCam is on its way to the Red Planet aboard Perseverance. We’ll talk with principal investigator Roger Wiens about the new and improved, laser-firing instrument that delivers rock spectra and other science from a distance. SuperCam’s microphone will finally let us listen to the Martian wind and more. Mastcam-Z is right next to SuperCam on the Perseverance mast. You’ve turned it into great acronyms that we’ll share in What’s Up. Links and…
classificationReason: Substantial interview about Perseverance rover instruments, including laser spectroscopy, microphone sensing, and Mastcam-Z.
qualityReason: Named principal-investigator interview focused on specific technical instruments and their capabilities.
